steps.meaning: The Ellsworth Falls Village Council holds its regular session on 8 September 2026 at 7:00 PM at the village hall, with Ordinance 2026-14 on the agenda for final action.
steps.name: council_session_occurs

steps.meaning: At least three council members are physically present in the chamber at the time of the vote on Ordinance 2026-14.
steps.name: quorum_present
steps.uncertainty: Whether at least three members are physically present is uncertain because Bianchi has filed notice of absence, and others may also be absent.

steps.meaning: The council votes on Ordinance 2026-14 at the 8 September session. Under council rules, the item is voted on unless the sponsor moves postponement.
steps.name: vote_taken
steps.uncertainty: It is uncertain whether the vote will occur because the sponsor (Okonkwo) could move postponement, though she has stated she wants final action.

steps.meaning: Council member Adaeze Okonkwo votes in favor of Ordinance 2026-14.
steps.name: okonkwo_vote_yes

steps.meaning: Council member Minh Tran votes in favor of Ordinance 2026-14.
steps.name: tran_vote_yes

steps.meaning: Council member Rosa Delgado votes against Ordinance 2026-14.
steps.name: delgado_vote_no

steps.meaning: Council member Gareth Pryce votes against Ordinance 2026-14.
steps.name: pryce_vote_no

steps.meaning: Council member Carla Bianchi is absent from the 8 September session, having filed written notice on 2 September.
steps.name: bianchi_absent

steps.meaning: The total number of affirmative votes on Ordinance 2026-14 is at least three.
steps.name: at_least_three_yes_votes
